title: Build objects from compact generators by a homotopy colimit
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with set-indexed coproducts and a set (E_i) of compact objects [def-pc-compact-object] whose coproduct is a generator [def-pc-generators]. Every object Y of C is a sequential homotopy colimit of a sequence X_1 \to X_2 \to \cdots, that is, there is a distinguished triangle \bigoplus_n X_n \xrightarrow{1-\mathrm{shift}} \bigoplus_n X_n \to Y \to (\bigoplus_n X_n)[1], where X_1 is a coproduct of shifts of the E_i and each transition X_n \to X_{n+1} fits into a distinguished triangle Z_n \to X_n \to X_{n+1} \to Z_n[1], where Z_n is a coproduct of shifts of the E_i.

proof.text: Form the initial coproduct indexed by triples (i,m,g), where g:E_i[m] → Y. Its coproduct-desc evaluation f₀ has a lift for every such g, namely its coprojection.

source.place: Tag 09SN, Lemma lemma-write-as-colimit, proof: comparison map and vanishing of its cone

proof.text: For each state (X,f:X → Y), form the coproduct Z of triples (i,m,g) with g:E_i[m] → X and g followed by f zero. Its evaluation a:Z → X has a followed by f zero by coproduct extensionality. Complete a to a distinguished triangle and use Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ to lift f to the next object. Each kernel map g is a summand of Z, so its composite with the transition is zero. This constructs the private GeneratorStep; generatorStep_exists is fully proved. Choose these proved steps and iterate by Nat.rec, retaining their triangle witnesses, coproduct presentations, compatible maps f_n and kernel-killing equations.

source.place: Tag 09SN, Lemma lemma-write-as-colimit, proof: comparison map and vanishing of its cone

proof.text: Complete identity minus transition shift on the countable coproduct to a distinguished triangle with third vertex H. The coproduct-desc of f_n kills that first arrow: check on each coprojection using transition compatibility. Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ gives c:H → Y; its coprojection restrictions give the comparison equations. Apply the generator-telescope isomorphism criterion to initial lifting and kernel killing. Transport the telescope triangle through c, using Triangle.isoMk with identity first and second components and inverse of c as third component.
